estimator.title: Morong Municipal Tax & Fee Estimator
estimator.subtitle: Instant client-side estimates for Cedula (CTC) and Real Property Tax (Amilyar)
estimator.propertyAssessedLabel: Real Property Owned in PH (Assessed Value, Optional)
estimator.latePaymentLabel: Paid after last day of February (Late Filing Penalty)
estimator.cedulaNote: Statutory maximum additional tax on income is capped at ₱5,000.00 by law.
estimator.assessedHelpTitle: Where to find your Assessed Value:
estimator.assessedHelpBody: Check your official Morong Tax Declaration (TD) under 'Assessed Value' (not Market Value). Assessed Value is already scaled by the municipal assessment level (e.g., 20% for residential land).
estimator.promptDiscountLabel: Apply Prompt Payment Discount (10% standard early payment)
estimator.promptDiscountHelp: Granted by the LGU when full annual amilyar or quarterly dues are settled on or before statutory due dates.
estimator.disclaimerBody: This fee calculator provides indicative estimates based on Republic Act No. 7160 (Local Government Code). Official tax assessments, municipal tax ordinance relief, prior-year delinquency penalties, and official receipts are exclusively processed by the Morong Municipal Treasurer’s Office at Municipal Hall.
